source_title: Cal. Veh. Code §21 Uniformity of code
second_source_title: 13 CCR Art. 3.8 adopted regulatory text (OAL file 2025-0415-04), CA DMV

source_title: 49 U.S.C. 40103 Sovereignty and use of airspace (United States Code, 2023 edition, GovInfo)
second_source_title: State and Local Regulation of Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) Fact Sheet, FAA Office of the Chief Counsel and DOT Office of the General Counsel, dated 2023-07-14 (FAA page last updated 2023-07-19)
evidence_summary: 49 U.S.C. 40103(a)(1) gives the US Government exclusive sovereignty of US airspace, and 40103(b) directs the FAA to plan and regulate use of the navigable airspace for safety and efficiency. The 2023 FAA/DOT fact sheet says states and localities may not regulate aviation safety or airspace efficiency but generally may regulate outside those fields; conflicting laws are preempted, and laws affecting commercial operators are more likely to be preempted.
analyst_note: CONTEXT_ONLY: identical in all 35 markets. The 2023 fact sheet (10-page PDF with DOT cover letter) updates the 2015 version; no later update found (FAA page last updated 2023-07-19). It is guidance, not binding regulation; preemption limits are ultimately for courts. FAA package delivery page adds that operators must follow state/local land-use and zoning rules when siting hubs. source_type FEDERAL_AGENCY used for the statute because the hierarchy has no federal-statute level. GovInfo 2023 edition used; later editions not checked.
